verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at framer.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured product summary. It links to agent-friendly markdown variants of pages via the ?md suffix (e.g. the switch, agents/external and developers pages), so an agent can be pointed directly at curated, machine-readable docs. missing for 10: an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec for the Server API (all candidate paths 404), consistent markdown access for the help center root (/help/.md returns 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
